title: Model selection read-back v1 (this project's recorded choice, its decision path, and the three answers kept apart)
$comment: Emitter: src/design_lab/model_selection.py (ModelSelection.readback), served by GET /api/projects/<id>/model-selection. What this envelope adds over the stored rows is the distinction between three states, because collapsing them is the failure this surface invites: CHOSEN is a recorded selection, DECLINED is the operator's explicit 「不用」, and NEVER_ASKED means nobody was asked -- an empty list is not a decision. The documents inside `selection` and every `history` element are $ref'd to design-lab/model-selection-v1.schema.json rather than restated here, so the record and the read-back cannot drift apart; they are validated on the way in by model_selection._check() and re-read from the stored bytes on the way out. `revision_count` counts rows, `history` carries the readable ones, and `unreadable_count` names the difference -- so NEVER_ASKED can occur with revision_count > 0 when every stored row failed to parse, which is why the only count invariant stated here is the one direction that always holds.

allOf.$comment: A project nobody was asked about cannot carry a selection, and a selection that says a model was chosen cannot be read out of a state that says otherwise.
